proof_body:
by
  intro f g a L M hf hg ε hε
  have hL : 0 < |L| + 1 := by positivity
  have hM : 0 < |M| + 1 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, h₁⟩ := hf (min 1 (ε / (2 * (|M| + 1)))) (lt_min one_pos (by positivity))
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, h₂⟩ := hg (ε / (2 * (|L| + 1))) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨min δ₁ δ₂, lt_min hδ₁ hδ₂, fun x h0 hx => ?_⟩
  have h3 := h₁ x h0 (lt_of_lt_of_le hx (min_le_left _ _))
  have h4 := h₂ x h0 (lt_of_lt_of_le hx (min_le_right _ _))
  have h3a : |f x - L| < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le h3 (min_le_left _ _)
  have h3b : |f x - L| < ε / (2 * (|M| + 1)) := lt_of_lt_of_le h3 (min_le_right _ _)
  have hfx : |f x| ≤ |L| + 1 := by
    have : |f x| ≤ |f x - L| + |L| := by simpa using abs_add_le (f x - L) L
    linarith
  have e : f x * g x - L * M = f x * (g x - M) + M * (f x - L) := by ring
  have b1 : |f x| * |g x - M| ≤ (|L| + 1) * |g x - M| := by gcongr
  have b2 : (|L| + 1) * |g x - M| < ε / 2 := by
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h4 hL
    have e2 : (|L| + 1) * (ε / (2 * (|L| + 1))) = ε / 2 := by field_simp
    linarith
  have b3 : |M| * |f x - L| ≤ (|M| + 1) * |f x - L| := by gcongr; linarith
  have b4 : (|M| + 1) * |f x - L| < ε / 2 := by
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h3b hM
    have e2 : (|M| + 1) * (ε / (2 * (|M| + 1))) = ε / 2 := by field_simp
    linarith
  rw [e]
  calc _ ≤ |f x * (g x - M)| + |M * (f x - L)| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ = |f x| * |g x - M| + |M| * |f x - L| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    _ < ε := by linarith
